answer: Each submission hangs on the atlas of a task receipt, and the ember is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
